"THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF, DESIGNED A VEXATIOUS LITIGANT, FAILED TO OBTAIN A PRE-FILING ORDER", PER JUDGE MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)

ORDER SETTING ASIDE AND VACATING SEPTEMBER 4, 2014 ORDER DISMISSING ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. THE COURT HEREBY SETS ASIDE AND VACATES ITS SEPTEMBER 4, 2014 ORDER DISMISSING THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. MS. STURIALE, THOUGH A VEXTATIOUS LITIGANT GENERALLY SUBJECT TO A PREFILING ORDER, DOES NOT NEED A PREFILING ORDER TO FILE AN ACTION IN SMALL CLAIMS COURT. (BANKS V. STATE OF CALIFORNIA (1993) 14 CAL. APP.4TH 1147, 1149.) THE CASE IS HEREBY REINSTATED.
